evidence.claim: The road over Westgard Pass predates numbered highways: it formed part of the Midland Trail, an early transcontinental automobile route.
evidence.quote: The eastern part of the route, from the eastern over Westgard Pass to the Nevada state line near Lida, Nevada predates the era of numbered highways and dates to the auto trail era as part of the Midland Trail, one of the earliest transcontinental roads in the USA.
